name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, fueled by late-night races broadcast from Europe. Initially pursuing a degree in business administration, Kenji quickly realized his passion lay in the people who fueled the sport. He shifted his focus to human resources, determined to contribute to the industry from the ground up.

As an HR Manager, Kenji emphasizes creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. He believes in fostering open communication and providing opportunities for professional growth. Kenji's flexible approach and commitment to employee well-being set him apart, enabling him to build strong relationships and drive positive change within any organization.

Kenji is dedicated to finding the best talent and nurturing a thriving atmosphere. He is confident he can make a big difference to any motorsport team he joins.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Kenji has a slender build and a calm, focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Prefers green tea over coffee, drinking several cups throughout the day.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when contemplating a decision.
